title: Languages and libraries
intro: Documentation is shared across projects and works offline. Add newer editions manually alongside existing versions.
importHelp: Enter the path to an already downloaded local ZIP. Atlas imports its text and builds a full-text index. Nothing is downloaded and examples are never executed. A different archive creates a separate edition; previous editions remain available.
empty: No references installed. Add a local archive below.
summaryCoverage: Page/API summary index; complete text preserved
fallback: Requested translation is unavailable; showing the available original.
candidate: Documentation explains an API. Verify source binding against receiver types and imports.
semanticFallback: Some semantic indexes are not ready. Exact / full-text search was used.
partial: Showing a bounded selection. Refine the query or select an edition.
